experiments.purpose: Empirically verify that Product cannot admit ~Copyable / ~Escapable arms in current Swift due to parameter-pack syntax limitations. Records the failure modes (`each T: ~Copyable` rejected; type-level upgrade rejected; binary swapped(_:) free function blocked at call site by Product's own type constraints) plus a CONFIRMED baseline that the existing Copyable + Escapable API works.
experiments.statusDetail: Tracking 3 upstream items: pack-syntax `each T: ~Copyable`, pack-syntax `each T: ~Escapable`, lifetime-annotation propagation through pack-expanded expressions. None have a public Swift Evolution proposal as of 2026-05-09. Outputs/build.txt + Outputs/build-6.4-dev.txt confirm the working CONFIRMED baseline.

experiments.purpose: Pre-publication exploration of arity-2 specialization shapes on Product (free function vs static method).
experiments.statusDetail: Free function shape selected for `swapped(_:)`; static-on-Product fails generic inference at nested call sites due to non-pack `<First, Second>` not binding the enclosing pack's `each Element`.
